experiment.name: Long Balanced Retrieval Diagnostic
experiment.research_object: T1 architecture with extended training on balanced one-hop retrieval

hypotheses.primary: Extended optimization allows T1's architecture to learn balanced retrieval.
hypotheses.null: Additional steps do not resolve the balanced retrieval bottleneck.

interpretation_boundary: Probe improvements establish incremental decodability under the stated controls; they do not by themselves establish causal use or metacognition.
